segments.name: Generation
segments.description: Produces energy from hydroelectric, wind and solar facilities for sale in regulated and free markets.
segments.evidence: Comprises production of energy from hydroelectric, wind and solar facilities, being characterized for the sale of the energy produced by the Company itself in the Regulated Market (ACR); under physical guarantee quotas; and to the segment of Trading.

segments.name: Transmission
segments.description: Constructs, operates and maintains transmission lines and substations for electricity distribution.
segments.evidence: Comprises construction, operation and maintenance of transmission lines and substations.

segments.name: Trading
segments.description: Sells energy to free customers and provides related services through energy purchases and intermediation.
segments.evidence: Comprises the sale of energy to free customers and the provision of related services.

segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Distributes and sells energy to captive customers and operates distribution infrastructure.
segments.evidence: comprises the distribution and sale of energy to captive customers, and the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and related services.

segments.name: Gas
segments.description: Operates commercial distribution and sale of piped gas to industrial, institutional and residential customers in Minas Gerais.
segments.evidence: this business segment includes commercial operation of industrial, institutional and residential distribution and sale of piped gas in the State of Minas Gerais.

segments.name: Investees
segments.description: Manages equity interests in jointly controlled entities and holding company activities aligned with business strategies.
segments.evidence: Comprises management of equity interests in jointly controlled entities, in line with the Company's business strategies.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for energy consumption at rates set by ANEEL for regulated customers; free customers negotiate rates; gas customers pay for piped gas distribution services.
revenueModel.evidence: We charge regulated customers for their actual energy consumption during each 30-day billing period at specified rates.

changes.text: In 2023, CEMIG sold its equity interests in Renova Energia S.A., Madeira Energia S.A., Baguari Energia, and Retiro Baixo Energética S.A. as part of strategic divestment program.
changes.evidence: On May 5, 2022, CEMIG concluded the sale of its entire CEMIG equity interest held in Renova Energia S.A.

changes.text: In 2021, CEMIG sold its remaining shares in Light S.A. to exit the investee segment.
changes.evidence: On January 22, 2021, the Company sold 68,621,264 shares that it held in that investee, at the price per share of R$20.00, in the total amount of R$1,372 million.
